answer: Each agent runs a listening post at one wharf recording the reef's daily sonar signature: ocean waves on the reef produce a unique echo, TPM-bound and hash-chained daily. Three established peers attest each post's timing and hash chain weekly; a missed day or broken chain seals the wharf for 30 days. The same reef signature claimed from two wharfs burns 400 POA from each and blacklists both. Cloning 100 agents needs 100 hydrophone rigs at $60 plus 100 devices at $110, with 80,000 POA locked 45 days and 40,000 POA at burn risk. A reef cannot sing the same song to two wharfs at once.
